newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasuries open lower ahead of jobless claims.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasuries open lower ahead of jobless claims.

text.p: U.S. Treasury prices opened lower on Thursday, extending Wednesday's losses as curve flattening trades continued to put pressure on the market.
The benchmark 30-year Treasury bond was off 6/32 to 95-19/32 in early trade, yielding 6.98 percent.
The spread between the 6.22 percent two-year yield and the 30-year yield had steepened to 76 basis points.
At the close of trade on Monday, the eve of the Federal Reserve's Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting, the 2- to 30-year spread was a flatter 65 basis points.
